identity.unit: Multiple spectra exported per identifier; nature not established
identity.conclusion: Sample identifier declared in M; frequencies of this identifier describe exported rows without establishing technical replicates. Index fields examined: source_replicate_id. The number of levels of a Rep factor is not used as the number of spectra per sample.
